name: Salt Mine
summary: A torchlit maze game in pink salt tunnels: gather crystals, keep the flame alive and ride the lift out
about: A dark mine page framed in timber beams, with a field journal, a map that fills in as you explore and a depth gauge that drops 40 metres a level. Every maze is new: your torch is the only light, it shrinks as the oil burns, and oil flasks, glowing salt crystals, a brass key and the amber lift wait in the dark. Bats roam the deeper tunnels and blow your flame low if they catch you.
how: A demo descent plays on load; press Descend, Take the torch or any arrow key to start.
Walk with the arrow keys or WASD, click or tap any tunnel you have already lit to walk there, or swipe to run along a corridor.
Pick up oil flasks to grow the flame; when it dies you strike one of two matches, then it is game over.
Reach the glowing lift to clear the level; from level 3 the gate is locked until you find the brass key.
Collect every crystal for a bonus; P or Escape pauses and R restarts with a fresh maze.
Your best score is kept on this device, and reduced motion removes the flicker, embers and light reveal.
